title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Sharma
description:
Motivation: Provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates and agent/tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and reduce repeated integration work. This PR adds opinionated RAG templates for common workflows (customer support and knowledge base search), a new tool-calling agent example that demonstrates structured tool outputs and error-handling, and corresponding docs site quickstarts and snippets.

What changed (high level): added two RAG template directories under redwood-examples with configurable embedding/indexing steps, added a Python and TypeScript agent that demonstrate tool-calling with structured outputs and retries, and updated the docs site nav and quickstart pages with runnable snippets and copy-paste examples. The docs content is written as quickstarts (short, copy/paste friendly) and includes a live example reference for the console.

Why: We continue to see customers reinventing the same glue code for vector stores, prompt templates, and tool orchestration. Packaging community-vetted templates and examples lowers the bar to production and lets us surface recommended defaults (e.g., prefix caching, chunking strategy, and fallback tool patterns).

Testing notes: Included unit tests for the agent shim and an integration smoke test that runs a small local vector store against the RAG template. CI required a single rerun due to a flaky network-dependent test (mock now added). Manual verification steps included running the Python quickstart and confirming tool calls generate expected structured JSON and that the RAG pipeline returns the top-3 supporting documents.

Migration/compatibility: No breaking changes. Examples and docs are additive. The quickstart snippets include both the Redwood SDK v1 and v2 patterns to ease upgrade friction.

Files of interest (high-level): redwood-examples/rag/templates/customer-support/ (template, README, sample prompts), redwood-examples/rag/templates/kb-search/ (indexing pipeline + chunking policy), redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/order-agent-python.py (tool-calling agent with structured output), redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/order-agent-ts.ts, redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-quickstart.md, redwood-docs/docs/examples/agents-tool-calling.md, redwood-docs/static/snippets/rag-quickstart.yaml.

Checklist: [x] Add templates and examples [x] Docs quickstarts added/updated [x] Unit + smoke tests [x] CI green after rerun [x] Reviewed and approved

Notes for reviewers: I focused on keeping the example agents minimal but realistic: the Python agent shows retry backoff and structured JSON tool responses; the TypeScript example demonstrates the same flow using the SDK sample helpers. Prompts are intentionally generic and labeled so teams can adapt them. If we want additional model presets or quantization suggestions, we can follow up in a separate PR (ENG-2415).
